title: Aquatic Milkweed
section_1_text: Monarchs may use Caterpillar Feeding only on Milkweed.

title: Frogfruit
section_1_text: Sunny weather does not remove stored Water from Frogfruit.

title: Common Sunflower
section_1_text: Sunflower may hold up to 4 Population.

title: Monarch Butterfly
section_1_text: Visit Milkweed, Frogfruit, Blue Mistflower, or Sunflower. Monarch +1 Population; plant +1 Population.
section_2_text: Feed on Milkweed. Monarch +1 Population; Milkweed -1 Population.

title: Eastern Carpenter Bee
section_1_text: May Pollinate any flowering plant in the garden.

title: Aphids
section_1_text: Milkweed, Blue Mistflower, Bluebonnet, or Sunflower. Aphids +1 Population; plant -1 Population.
section_2_text: If Aphids and Red Imported Fire Ants are in the same Garden Plot, whenever these Aphids successfully Feed, the Fire Ants also gain +1 Population. While protected by Fire Ants, these Aphids cannot be hunted by Milkweed Assassin Bugs or Aphid Parasitoid Wasps. Brown Anoles and Carolina Wrens can still hunt them.

title: Milkweed Assassin Bug
section_1_text: Aphids, Monarch Butterflies, Eastern Carpenter Bees, or Aphid Parasitoid Wasps anywhere in the garden.
section_2_text: Cannot hunt Aphids protected by Red Imported Fire Ants.

title: Aphid Parasitoid Wasp
section_1_text: Hunt Aphids anywhere in the garden.
section_2_text: Cannot hunt other organisms. Cannot hunt Aphids protected by Red Imported Fire Ants.

title: Red Imported Fire Ant
section_1_text: Protect Aphids in your Garden Plot. Whenever those Aphids successfully Feed, Fire Ants gain +1 Population.
section_2_text: Monarch Butterfly, Eastern Carpenter Bee, Milkweed Assassin Bug, or Aphid Parasitoid Wasp.

title: Brown Anole
section_1_text: Any insect anywhere in the garden.
section_2_text: Fire Ant protection does not protect Aphids from Brown Anoles.

title: Carolina Wren
section_1_text: Any insect or Brown Anole anywhere in the garden.

title: Turkey Tail Fungus
section_1_text: Move 1 Compost counter to the Nutrient position beside one of your plants. Turkey Tail gains +1 Population.

title: Soil Bacterium
section_1_text: Move 1 Compost counter to the Nutrient position beside one of your plants.
section_2_text: At 2+ Population, it may instead move 2 Compost to 2 Nutrients with one activation.

title: Rainstorm
category: EFFECT - play instead of an organism
section_1_text: Add 1 Water below every plant in the garden.

title: Drought
category: EFFECT - play instead of an organism
section_1_text: Remove 1 Water from every plant in the garden that has Water.

title: Heat Wave
category: EFFECT - play instead of an organism
section_1_text: Remove 1 Water from every plant in the garden. Then choose one plant you control; it gains +1 Population if it still has at least 1 Water remaining.

title: Compost Addition
category: EFFECT - play instead of an organism
section_1_text: Add 2 counters from the supply directly to the shared Compost area.

title: Mulch
category: EFFECT - play instead of an organism
section_1_text: Choose one plant you control. Place this card under it until the start of your next turn. Sunny-weather evaporation does not remove Water from that plant. Then discard Mulch.

title: Native Plant Boom
category: EFFECT - play instead of an organism
section_1_text: Choose one native plant you control. It gains +1 Population, up to its maximum.

title: Pesticide Spray
category: EFFECT - play instead of an organism
section_1_text: Choose one Garden Plot. Every insect in that plot loses 1 Population. Move all lost Population to Compost.
